AI.summary: 本文聚焦“大模型如何适应多元且可能相互冲突的人类偏好”这一问题。作者通过覆盖五国、1.5万人的多语言调查，量化比较人类偏好和21个前沿LLM，发现模型输出远比人类偏好单一；同时分析现有偏好数据收集流程，指出由于候选回答同质化，模型难以学习真实存在的价值多样性。为此，作者提出在候选生成中引入“负相关采样”，通过简单的prompt设计刻意生成相互差异乃至冲突的候选答案，并实证表明这种方法显著提升了对齐算法在学习异质偏好时的表现。在此基础上，他们构建并开源了 Community Alignment 数据集，一个包含233,319次比较、覆盖五国、支持多语言和多轮对话的偏好数据集，用于推动面向全球多元用户的LLM对齐研究。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 多元价值对齐, 偏好学习, 负相关采样, 多语言数据集, 多轮对话, 人类偏好多样性, Community Alignment 数据集, 算法单一文化
AI.comments: 研究强调了当前主流LLM在价值观与偏好层面的“单一文化”问题，并给出了一个数据与方法上的系统回应：通过负相关采样强化候选多样性，以及构建规模更大、地域更广的偏好数据集。局限在摘要中未详细说明，如具体国家分布、偏好维度的选择、以及模型性能提升的定量指标，但数据集开源有望成为后续实证与方法改进的重要基础。

title: Anthropomimetic Uncertainty: What Verbalized Uncertainty in Language Models is Missing
summary: Human users increasingly communicate with large language models (LLMs), but LLMs suffer from frequent overconfidence in their output, even when its accuracy is questionable, which undermines their trustworthiness and perceived legitimacy. Therefore, there is a need for language models to signal their confidence in order to reap the benefits of human-machine collaboration and mitigate potential harms. Verbalized uncertainty is the expression of confidence with linguistic means, an approach that integrates perfectly into language-based interfaces. Most recent research in natural language processing (NLP) overlooks the nuances surrounding human uncertainty communication and the biases that influence the communication of and with machines. We argue for anthropomimetic uncertainty, the principle that intuitive and trustworthy uncertainty communication requires a degree of imitation of human linguistic behaviors. We present a thorough overview of the research in human uncertainty communication, survey ongoing research in NLP, and perform additional analyses to demonstrate so-far underexplored biases in verbalized uncertainty. We conclude by pointing out unique factors in human-machine uncertainty and outlining future research directions towards implementing anthropomimetic uncertainty.

AI.title_translation: 拟人化不确定性：语言模型中口头不确定性所缺失的
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLMs）常因过度自信而损害信任。本文提出“拟人化不确定性”原则，主张LLMs应模仿人类语言行为来更可靠地表达不确定性。论文概述了人类不确定性沟通和NLP研究，并揭示了口头不确定性中的未探索偏差，为未来人机不确定性沟通指明方向。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在输出中频繁表现出过度自信，即使其准确性存疑，这损害了它们的信任度和合法性。为了促进人机协作并减轻潜在危害，LLMs需要能够清晰地表达其置信度。现有的自然语言处理（NLP）研究通常忽视人类不确定性沟通的细微差别以及影响人机沟通的偏见。
AI.method: 本文提出了“拟人化不确定性”原则，即直观和值得信赖的不确定性沟通需要一定程度地模仿人类语言行为。研究方法包括对人类不确定性沟通研究进行全面概述，调查自然语言处理（NLP）中正在进行的相关研究，并进行额外分析以展示口头不确定性中迄今未被充分探索的偏差。
AI.result: 本文演示了口头不确定性中迄今未被充分探索的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 本文指出了人机不确定性中的独特因素，并概述了未来研究方向，旨在实现拟人化不确定性。
AI.translation: 人类用户越来越多地与大型语言模型（LLM）进行交流，但LLM在输出中常常表现出过度自信，即使其准确性值得怀疑，这损害了它们的信任度和感知合法性。因此，语言模型需要表明其置信度，以获取人机协作的益处并减轻潜在危害。口头不确定性是指通过语言方式表达置信度，这种方法完美地融入了基于语言的界面。最近大多数自然语言处理（NLP）研究忽视了围绕人类不确定性沟通的细微差别以及影响与机器沟通的偏见。我们主张采用拟人化不确定性，即直观和值得信赖的不确定性沟通需要一定程度地模仿人类语言行为的原则。我们全面概述了人类不确定性沟通的研究，调查了NLP中正在进行的研究，并进行了额外的分析以展示口头不确定性中迄今未被充分探索的偏差。我们最后指出人机不确定性中的独特因素，并概述了实现拟人化不确定性的未来研究方向。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）在表达不确定性方面的不足，指出其过度自信损害了用户信任。为解决此问题，作者提出了“拟人化不确定性”原则，强调LLM应模仿人类语言行为来更直观、可信地表达不确定性。文章回顾了人类不确定性沟通和NLP相关研究，并揭示了口头不确定性中的未探索偏差，最后提出了未来研究方向以实现拟人化不确定性。
AI.keywords: 拟人化不确定性, 语言模型, 口头不确定性, 人机协作, 置信度表达
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了“拟人化不确定性”这一概念，强调了语言模型在表达不确定性时应模仿人类的沟通方式，这对于提升LLM的可靠性和人机交互的信任度具有重要意义。它超越了简单地量化置信度，而是关注其语言表达的细微之处和人类偏见，为未来的LLM设计提供了新的视角。

title: NetForge: A Programmable Substrate for Bottleneck-Centric Network Data Generation
summary: The behavior of Internet applications is shaped by congestion dynamics at bottleneck links, yet data capturing application behavior across diverse bottleneck regimes remains scarce. Bridging this gap requires a data-generation substrate that simultaneously provides controllability, composability, fidelity, and replicability--capabilities existing approaches struggle to achieve simultaneously. This paper introduces NetForge, a programmable substrate for bottleneck-centric data generation guided by progressive disaggregation: NetForge (i) decouples bottleneck intent from execution, (ii) separates static bottleneck attributes from dynamic congestion pressure, and (iii) disaggregates observed demand dynamics from their original trace context via Cross-Traffic Profiles (CTPs). CTPs transform passive packet traces into reusable, composable pressure signals that can be selected and transformed to specify dynamic bottleneck behavior. Our evaluation shows that NetForge satisfies the four requirements and, in an ABR case study, generates data that remains realistic, expands coverage into underrepresented regimes, and, in turn, improves model performance by up to 47% by reducing transmission-time prediction error of the Fugu model. Together, these results establish NetForge as a practical substrate for studying Internet application behavior across diverse bottleneck regimes.

AI.title_translation: NetForge：一种面向瓶颈的可编程网络数据生成基底
AI.tldr: 提出 NetForge 可编程数据生成基底，通过可重用的交叉流量剖面精确控制瓶颈行为，生成高保真、可复现且覆盖更广场景的网络数据，在 ABR 场景中将 Fugu 模型的传输时间预测误差最多降低 47%。
AI.motivation: 互联网应用行为深受瓶颈链路拥塞动态影响，但目前缺乏覆盖多种瓶颈状态、同时具备可控性、可组合性、真实度和可复现性的数据生成手段，现有方法无法同时满足这些需求，因此需要新的数据生成基底来系统研究不同瓶颈条件下的应用行为。
AI.method: 提出 NetForge，可编程的瓶颈中心数据生成基底，遵循“渐进式解耦”设计：(1) 将瓶颈意图与执行解耦；(2) 将静态瓶颈属性与动态拥塞压力分离；(3) 通过交叉流量剖面（CTPs）将观测到的需求动态从原始追踪上下文中拆出。CTPs 把被动抓取的包追踪转化为可复用、可组合的压力信号，用户可以选择和变换这些信号以指定动态瓶颈行为，用于生成不同拥塞状态下的网络数据。
AI.result: 评估表明 NetForge 同时满足可控性、可组合性、真实度和可复现性四个需求。在自适应比特率（ABR）案例研究中，NetForge 生成的数据既保持真实性，又扩展到以往数据中代表性不足的瓶颈状态，并使 Fugu 模型的传输时间预测误差最多降低 47%。
AI.conclusion: NetForge 证明了通过解耦瓶颈意图、属性与压力，并引入可组合的交叉流量剖面，可以构建一个实用的、面向瓶颈的网络数据生成基底，为在多样化瓶颈状态下系统研究互联网应用行为提供了有效工具，并能显著提升依赖这些数据的模型性能。
AI.translation: 互联网应用的行为受瓶颈链路上的拥塞动态所塑造，然而能够覆盖多样瓶颈状态并捕捉应用行为的数据仍然十分稀缺。弥合这一差距需要一种同时具备可控性、可组合性、真实度和可复现性的数据生成基底，而现有方法难以同时实现这些能力。本文提出 NetForge，一种由渐进式解耦思想驱动的、面向瓶颈的数据生成可编程基底：NetForge (i) 将瓶颈“意图”与其执行过程解耦；(ii) 将静态瓶颈属性与动态拥塞压力分离；以及 (iii) 通过交叉流量剖面（CTPs）将观测到的需求动态从其原始追踪上下文中解耦。CTPs 将被动获取的包追踪转化为可复用、可组合的压力信号，这些信号可以被选择和变换，用于指定瓶颈的动态行为。我们的评估显示，NetForge 满足上述四项需求，并且在一个 ABR 案例研究中，NetForge 生成的数据既保持现实性，又将覆盖范围扩展到以往代表性不足的状态，从而使 Fugu 模型的传输时间预测误差最多降低 47%。这些结果共同表明，NetForge 是一个实用的基底，用于在多种瓶颈状态下研究互联网应用行为。
AI.summary: 论文提出 NetForge，一个专门针对网络瓶颈行为的数据生成平台，目标是在模拟不同拥塞状态时兼顾可控性、可组合性、高保真和可复现性。其核心设计是对瓶颈进行多层解耦：分离“想要什么样的瓶颈行为”与“如何实现”，分离瓶颈的静态资源特性与动态拥塞压力，并通过交叉流量剖面（CTPs）将真实抓包中的需求动态抽取出来，作为可复用、可组合的压力信号，用于驱动瓶颈行为。实验表明，NetForge 能实现预期的灵活与精确控制，在自适应比特率视频（ABR）场景中生成的流量既真实又覆盖到以往数据中较少出现的瓶颈状态，从而使 Fugu 模型的传输时间预测误差最高下降 47%，展示了对基于数据的网络应用建模具有实质性帮助。
AI.keywords: 可编程网络, 数据生成基底, 网络瓶颈, 拥塞控制, 交叉流量剖面(CTP), 被动测量, 自适应比特率(ABR), Fugu 模型, 网络流量建模, 拥塞动态
AI.comments: 摘要突出 NetForge 在设计上的“解耦”和“可组合”特性，并给出一个 ABR+Fugu 的具体应用示例来量化收益（最高 47% 误差降低），说明该方法对下游模型训练具有明显实际价值。局限性与开销、可扩展性等细节尚未在摘要中给出，需查阅正文了解其在更大规模网络、更多应用类型下的通用性与部署成本。

title: ViGText: Deepfake Image Detection with Vision-Language Model Explanations and Graph Neural Networks
summary: The rapid rise of deepfake technology, which produces realistic but fraudulent digital content, threatens the authenticity of media. Traditional deepfake detection approaches often struggle with sophisticated, customized deepfakes, especially in terms of generalization and robustness against malicious attacks. This paper introduces ViGText, a novel approach that integrates images with Vision Large Language Model (VLLM) Text explanations within a Graph-based framework to improve deepfake detection. The novelty of ViGText lies in its integration of detailed explanations with visual data, as it provides a more context-aware analysis than captions, which often lack specificity and fail to reveal subtle inconsistencies. ViGText systematically divides images into patches, constructs image and text graphs, and integrates them for analysis using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to identify deepfakes. Through the use of multi-level feature extraction across spatial and frequency domains, ViGText captures details that enhance its robustness and accuracy to detect sophisticated deepfakes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ViGText significantly enhances generalization and achieves a notable performance boost when it detects user-customized deepfakes. Specifically, average F1 scores rise from 72.45% to 98.32% under generalization evaluation, and reflects the model's superior ability to generalize to unseen, fine-tuned variations of stable diffusion models. As for robustness, ViGText achieves an increase of 11.1% in recall compared to other deepfake detection approaches. When facing targeted attacks that exploit its graph-based architecture, ViGText limits classification performance degradation to less than 4%. ViGText uses detailed visual and textual analysis to set a new standard for detecting deepfakes, helping ensure media authenticity and information integrity.

AI.title_translation: ViGText：基于视觉-语言模型解释和图神经网络的深度伪造图像检测
AI.tldr: ViGText利用视觉-语言模型解释和图神经网络来提高深度伪造图像检测的泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造技术迅速崛起，产生逼真但虚假的数字内容，威胁着媒体的真实性。传统的深度伪造检测方法在处理复杂、定制化的深度伪造方面，尤其在泛化性和对抗恶意攻击的鲁棒性方面表现不佳。
AI.method: ViGText将图像与视觉大语言模型（VLLM）文本解释集成到基于图的框架中。它将图像分割成补丁，构建图像图和文本图，并使用图神经网络（GNNs）进行分析。通过在空间和频率域进行多层次特征提取，捕获细节以增强鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.result: ViGText显著增强了泛化性，在检测用户定制深度伪造时性能显著提升。泛化评估下，平均F1分数从72.45%提高到98.32%。鲁棒性方面，召回率比其他方法提高了11.1%。面对针对其图架构的攻击时，分类性能下降不到4%。
AI.conclusion: ViGText通过详细的视觉和文本分析，为深度伪造检测设定了新标准，有助于确保媒体真实性和信息完整性。
AI.translation: 深度伪造技术迅速崛起，产生逼真但虚假的数字内容，威胁着媒体的真实性。传统的深度伪造检测方法在处理复杂的、定制化的深度伪造时常常力不从心，尤其是在泛化性和对抗恶意攻击的鲁棒性方面。本文介绍了一种名为ViGText的新方法，它将图像与视觉大语言模型（VLLM）文本解释集成到基于图的框架中，以改进深度伪造检测。ViGText的创新之处在于它将详细解释与视觉数据相结合，提供了比字幕更具情境感知的分析，因为字幕通常缺乏特异性，未能揭示细微的不一致性。ViGText系统地将图像分割成补丁，构建图像图和文本图，并使用图神经网络（GNNs）集成进行分析以识别深度伪造。通过在空间和频率域使用多层次特征提取，ViGText捕获了增强其鲁棒性和准确性以检测复杂深度伪造的细节。大量实验表明，ViGText显著增强了泛化性，并在检测用户定制深度伪造时实现了显著的性能提升。具体而言，在泛化评估下，平均F1分数从72.45%上升到98.32%，反映了该模型对未见过的、经过微调的稳定扩散模型变体的卓越泛化能力。在鲁棒性方面，与其它深度伪造检测方法相比，ViGText的召回率提高了11.1%。在面对利用其基于图的架构的定向攻击时，ViGText将分类性能下降限制在4%以内。ViGText利用详细的视觉和文本分析，为检测深度伪造设定了新标准，有助于确保媒体真实性和信息完整性。
AI.summary: ViGText是一种新颖的深度伪造图像检测方法，它将视觉大语言模型（VLLM）生成的文本解释与图像数据结合，并通过图神经网络（GNNs）进行分析。该方法将图像分割成补丁并构建图像图和文本图，利用多层次特征提取来捕捉细节。实验证明，ViGText在泛化性和鲁棒性方面表现出色，显著提高了对定制化深度伪造的检测F1分数和召回率，并有效抵御了定向攻击。
AI.keywords: 深度伪造检测, 视觉-语言模型, 图神经网络, 泛化性, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将VLLM生成的文本解释与视觉数据相结合，并通过图神经网络进行深度伪造检测。这种方法提供了比传统字幕更具情境感知的分析，能够捕捉到细微的不一致性，从而显著提高了模型的泛化性和鲁棒性，尤其是在处理复杂和定制化深度伪造方面。

title: Decomposing Representation Space into Interpretable Subspaces with Unsupervised Learning
comments: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary: Understanding internal representations of neural models is a core interest of mechanistic interpretability. Due to its large dimensionality, the representation space can encode various aspects about inputs. To what extent are different aspects organized and encoded in separate subspaces? Is it possible to find these ``natural'' subspaces in a purely unsupervised way? Somewhat surprisingly, we can indeed achieve this and find interpretable subspaces by a seemingly unrelated training objective. Our method, neighbor distance minimization (NDM), learns non-basis-aligned subspaces in an unsupervised manner. Qualitative analysis shows subspaces are interpretable in many cases, and encoded information in obtained subspaces tends to share the same abstract concept across different inputs, making such subspaces similar to ``variables'' used by the model. We also conduct quantitative experiments using known circuits in GPT-2; results show a strong connection between subspaces and circuit variables. We also provide evidence showing scalability to 2B models by finding separate subspaces mediating context and parametric knowledge routing. Viewed more broadly, our findings offer a new perspective on understanding model internals and building circuits.
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026

title: CoAct-1: Computer-using Multi-Agent System with Coding Actions
summary: Autonomous agents that operate computers via Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) often struggle with efficiency and reliability on complex, long-horizon tasks. While augmenting these agents with planners can improve task decomposition, they remain constrained by the inherent limitations of performing all actions through GUI manipulation, leading to brittleness and inefficiency. In this work, we introduce a more robust and flexible paradigm: enabling agents to use coding as a enhanced action. We present CoAct-1, a novel multi-agent system that synergistically combines GUI-based control with direct programmatic execution. CoAct-1 features an Orchestrator that dynamically delegates subtasks to either a conventional GUI Operator or a specialized Programmer agent, which can write and execute Python or Bash scripts. This hybrid approach allows the agent to bypass inefficient GUI action sequences for tasks like file management and data processing, while still leveraging visual interaction when necessary. We evaluate our system on the challenging OSWorld benchmark, where CoAct-1 achieves a new state-of-the-art success rate of 60.76%, significantly outperforming prior methods. Furthermore, our approach dramatically improves efficiency, reducing the average number of steps required to complete a task to just 10.15, compared to 15 for leading GUI agents. Our results demonstrate that integrating coding as a core action provides a more powerful, efficient, and scalable path toward generalized computer automation.

title: Share Your Attention: Transformer Weight Sharing via Matrix-based Dictionary Learning
comments: This work has been accepted and presented at AAAI 2026 in Singapore
summary: Large language models have revolutionized AI applications, yet their high computational and memory demands hinder their widespread deployment. Existing compression techniques focus on intra-block optimizations (e.g., low-rank approximation or attention pruning), while the repetitive layered structure of transformers implies significant inter-block redundancy - a dimension largely unexplored beyond key-value (KV) caching. Inspired by dictionary learning in convolutional networks, we propose a framework for structured weight sharing across transformer layers. Our approach decomposes attention projection matrices (Q, K, V, O) into shared dictionary atoms, reducing the attention module's parameters by 66.7\% while achieving on-par performance. Unlike complex methods requiring distillation or architectural changes, MASA (Matrix Atom Sharing in Attention) operates as a drop-in replacement-trained with standard optimizers - and represents each layer's weights as linear combinations of shared matrix atoms. Experiments across scales (100M-700M parameters) show that MASA achieves better benchmark accuracy and perplexity than GQA, low-rank baselines and recent Repeat-all-over/Sequential sharing at comparable parameter budgets. Ablation studies confirm robustness to the dictionary size and the efficacy of shared representations in capturing cross-layer statistical regularities. Extending to Vision Transformers (ViT), MASA matches performance metrics on image classification tasks with 66.7\% fewer attention parameters. By combining dictionary learning strategies with transformer efficiency, MASA offers a scalable blueprint for parameter-efficient models without sacrificing performance. Finally, we investigate the possibility of employing MASA on large pretrained models to reduce their number of parameters without experiencing any significant drop in their performance.

AI.title_translation: 分享你的注意力：基于矩阵字典学习的Transformer权重共享
AI.tldr: 提出MASA框架，通过矩阵字典学习共享Transformer注意力投影矩阵（Q、K、V、O），减少66.7%注意力参数，性能不降。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型计算和内存需求高，现有压缩技术关注层内优化，而Transformer重复分层结构导致层间冗余未充分探索。
AI.method: MASA（注意力中的矩阵原子共享）将注意力投影矩阵分解为共享字典原子，每层权重表示为共享矩阵原子的线性组合，作为即插即用替换，用标准优化器训练。
AI.result: 在100M-700M参数规模实验中，MASA在可比参数预算下优于GQA、低秩基线及近期重复/顺序共享方法，基准准确率和困惑度更高；扩展到ViT，图像分类任务性能匹配，注意力参数减少66.7%。
AI.conclusion: MASA将字典学习策略与Transformer效率结合，为参数高效模型提供可扩展蓝图，不牺牲性能；还可用于大型预训练模型以减少参数而无显著性能下降。
